OJ Electronics is looking for a hardware development manager to lead one of the core development units within our R&D organization. This is a central leadership role focused on strengthening both engineering capability and development capacity across our product portfolio.

OJ Electronics – a Danish producer of HVAC drives, AHU controllers, and thermostats for electric floor heating – is looking for an experienced engineering leader to join our R&D organization in Sønderborg, Denmark.

In this role, you will lead a team of approximately 10 specialists within hardware and mechanical engineering, supporting the continued development of new products and technologies across OJ’s three main product areas. You’ll combine people leadership, technical understanding, resource coordination, and process improvement in a dynamic development environment with close collaboration across R&D, product management, and senior leadership.

As part of OJ’s broader R&D leadership team, you’ll help shape development priorities, strengthen engineering processes, and contribute to an organization where ideas quickly become action.

Your role

As hardware development manager, you’ll be responsible for the daily leadership and continued development of OJ’s hardware team.

Your specific responsibilities will include:

• Leading and developing the hardware team

• Supporting employee development and long-term competence building

• Allocating development resources across projects and priorities

• Participating as part of OJ’s R&D leadership team alongside fellow department leaders

• Collaborating with external development partners

• Managing budgets and follow-up activities for hardware development

• Contributing to process optimization and continuous improvement across development activities

Must-have qualifications

• Engineering degree in electronics or a related technical field

• Leadership experience – preferably within product development or technical organizations

• Strong technical understanding of electronics and hardware development

• Experience leading technical specialists and cross-functional collaboration

• Strong communication skills in both Danish and English

• Structured leadership approach with focus on collaboration, overview, and execution

• Ability to balance empathy and listening skills with clear decision-making when needed

Nice-to-have qualifications

• Experience working with hardware development and MCAD/ECAD tools

• Experience working with development processes in companies with dedicated R&D organizations

• Understanding of both technical development and organizational process improvement

• Experience collaborating with external development partners

• Interest in leadership development and building strong engineering teams

Working at OJ

At OJ Electronics, you’ll find an informal, open and collaborative culture where people take pride in doing quality work.

We offer:

• A flat organisational structure where decisions are made quickly

• Opportunities to grow your expertise and responsibility over time

• A healthy work-life balance and flexible working hours

• Competitive salary and pension package

• A modern workplace with canteen and good facilities

Employee satisfaction scores average above 85 – and we take pride in maintaining a workplace where people truly thrive.

Please note that this position is based in Sønderborg, Denmark, and requires your physical presence on site. This is not a hybrid or remote position.

The application process

For this position, we will be interviewing on an ongoing basis until we find the right person.

About OJ Electronics

Founded in 1964 and headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark, OJ Electronics produces electronic controls for underfloor heating and HVAC controls and drives. Our products are available through partners and distributors worldwide, and we have subsidiaries and sales offices in key markets, including the United States and Poland. Everywhere, we are known for our innovative approach, insistence on product quality, and deep application knowledge – all of which helps customers differentiate themselves in the market.

In June 2023, OJ Electronics was acquired by BITZER Electronics, a BITZER Group company also headquartered in Sønderborg. Do you know how to turn ideas into engaging video content? Are you passionate about storytelling, visual communication, and creating content that people want to watch? Then you might be the Creative Video Producer we’re looking for.

At JYSK, video is a key part of how we communicate with customers and colleagues across more than 30 countries. Healper a game-changing booking platform that matches people with mental health issues such as depression, anxiety, and addiction with the psychologist who fits their needs. Problem: The cumbersome booking of the wrong psychologist In Denmark, mental disorders account for 25% of the disease burden and cost society 55 billion DKK annually with more than 2,000 people receiving therapy from a psychologist every day. Further, too many individuals do not receive timely help as they cannot cope with the draining 5-hour process it takes to find and book a psychologist. At the same time, U.S. experience shows that only 20-40% of people find a psychologist they trust and have 'chemistry' with. This is tragic, as just one bad experience can cause a client to completely drop out of or postpone his/her therapy. The ineffective booking process and the risk of a poor patient-therapist match mean that many people continue to struggle with mental illness who could otherwise be treated. This has major consequences for individuals whose mental illness markedly impairs their quality of life, but also largely affect their family and friends. Furthermore, this is a major problem for society, which is negatively impacted by lost labor and growth and must shoulder the high costs associated with mental illness. Solution: A simple approach to booking the right psychologist Healper is a friendly guide and a booking platform that matches clients with psychologists. We have designed a comfortable, simple, and transparent user journey, that takes the client by the hand and helps him/her through therapy to mental health. Clients fill out a short questionnaire and are then matched with the best results from our database of more than 1,700 psychologists. Here, we find the psychologist who can statistically give the best treatment. Clients are presented with a prioritized list of three psychologists along with the reasons for the match. From this list, clients can choose which psychologist they like best, book a session, and pay. The platform continuously facilitates feedback from clients and their psychologists to improve the processing and precision of the matches.

Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Student Assistant to join our team and support commercial finance activities for International Markets. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain and Trade Operations, supporting forecasting, reporting and financial analysis across multiple geographies.

You will help ensure good data quality, support recurring finance processes and contribute to analyses used in decision-making, while learning how Finance partners with commercial and operational teams in a global biotech setup.

• Are motivated to learn, ask questions and develop your finance and analytical skills

The job

About the position

Solvexis Consult is looking for an experienced Lifting & Rigging Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support a major construction project.

As the project’s technical specialist for lifting and rigging, you will help ensure that lifting activities are properly planned, reviewed and executed safely. You will provide specialist guidance to the project team, contractors and subcontractors and support compliance with applicable legislation, project procedures and recognized industry practice.

The role requires extensive practical and technical experience with lifting operations on large construction or industrial projects.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Acting as the project’s subject matter expert for lifting, rigging and crane-related activities.

• 
Developing, reviewing and maintaining project procedures and minimum requirements for lifting operations.

• 
Reviewing lift plans, risk assessments, method statements and supporting technical documentation.

• 
Assessing routine, non-routine, complex and critical lifting operations.

• 
Reviewing crane selection, load charts, lifting radius, capacity utilization and equipment configuration.

• 
Verifying load information, including weight, dimensions, center of gravity and lifting points.

• 
Reviewing rigging arrangements, lifting accessories and equipment selection.

• 
Assessing crane positioning, ground conditions, outrigger loads and required ground support in cooperation with the relevant engineering disciplines.

• 
Ensuring that exclusion zones, communication methods and responsibilities are clearly defined before lifting begins.

• 
Confirming that lifting equipment and accessories have valid certification, inspections and identification.

• 
Reviewing the competence and documentation of crane operators, riggers, signalers, lifting supervisors and other personnel involved in lifting operations.

• 
Supporting contractor and subcontractor evaluations related to lifting competence and performance.

• 
Participating in planning meetings, constructability reviews, pre-lift meetings and toolbox talks.

• 
Conducting site inspections and audits of lifting and rigging activities.

• 
Identifying unsafe conditions, procedural deviations and technical risks and ensuring that these are addressed.

• 
Supporting coordination between construction, logistics, engineering, HSE and commissioning teams.

• 
Advising the project on simultaneous operations and interfaces that may affect lifting activities.

• 
Supporting investigations of lifting-related incidents and near misses and communicating lessons learned.

• 
Maintaining clear records and reporting lifting-related risks, observations and required actions to project management.

• 
Reviewing and approving lifting documentation when formally authorized to do so by the project.

Qualifications and experience

We expect that you have:

• 
A relevant technical, engineering, crane, rigging or construction background.

• 
Extensive documented experience with lifting and rigging operations on large construction or industrial projects.

• 
Previous experience as a lifting specialist, appointed person, lifting manager, lift planner, lifting supervisor or equivalent.

• 
Strong knowledge of cranes, rigging equipment, lifting accessories and safe lifting practices.

• 
Experience developing and reviewing lift plans, risk assessments and method statements.

Global Business Services (GBS) Finance Transformation Manager

• Full-time

• Field of interest: Technology, Transformation & Data

• Level of hire: Experienced hire

Company Description

With more than 2,700 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology, and Transformations.

About our team

Finance Transformation is part of Deloitte’s consulting practice and consists of 350 dedicated consultants who work within all aspects of the CFO area and engage with clients to advise, transform, optimise, and operate the finance function. We have private and public as well as national and international clients across different industries and of different sizes, and we work with the lion’s share of C25 companies and public institutions.

Global Business Services (GBS) is an integral part of Deloitte’s Finance Transformation practice. The GBS team is dedicated to helping organizations transform their business operations, driving higher efficiency, effectiveness, and agility. By leveraging a comprehensive suite of services, the GBS practice supports clients in optimizing shared services, outsourcing, and global business service models to create value and enhance performance.

We are seeking an experienced and skilled Transformation Manager to join our GBS team. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of operating model structures and Business Process Re-engineering driven through the lens of cost optimization and efficiency augmentation, experience with the interplay of technology and process design, and change management capabilities. This role will be pivotal in driving strategic business transformation initiatives, focusing on re-enforcing cost optimization strategies by energizing core operational processes and technology design and implementation phases (ERP, process mining, automation and visualization tools).

Job Description

As a Transformation Manager, you will lead large complex engagements for some of the world's biggest organizations. You will identify, design, and implement creative business and technology solutions aimed at driving operational effectiveness, cost efficiencies and organizational agility. In this role, you will architect strategies and transformation programs that will enable process excellence and value creation by optimizing day-to-day operational finance functions using lean methodology in end-to-end process areas such as order to cash, procure to pay, close, consolidation, reporting. You will be responsible for leading business model transformations and cultivating enterprise agility to ensure transformations are anchored in, and unlock, value.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Leading Project Delivery

• Driving large scale transformations, complex and cross functional engagements

• Advising clients on process re-engineering and process optimization to support enterprise-wide decision-making, improve finance operations, and strengthen stakeholder management

• Lead the technology solution design and implementation ensuring high quality adhering to the timelines and defined budget

• Engaging in Executive- Level Interactions

• Partner with C-level executives to address strategic objectives and challenges.

• Present actionable strategies in clear, compelling terms.

• Driving Business Development

• Lead RFPs/ proposal preparation by collaborating across competencies/ alliances/ service lines.

• Cultivate and nurture client relationships beyond project delivery, exploring avenues for repeat business.

• Stakeholder Management

• Build and maintain strong connections with CXOs across various sectors.

• Project Financials

• Manage budgets and financial performance for your projects.

• Mentorship and Team Culture-

• Mentor and guide a team of consultants, fostering a positive and collaborative culture.

• Encourage professional growth and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Ideally, you have:

• Around 6-9 years of relevant experience in finance transformation, finance process excellence, GBS, Shared Services and/or BPO sector

• 4+ years of Direct people management experience

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university

• Fluency in Danish is a big plus

What you bring to the team:

• Experience with process excellence, including but not limited to end-to-end process areas such as order to cash, procure to pay, close, consolidation, reporting

• Knowledge of GBS lifecycle and able to run projects in it as a Project Manager

• Experience with enabling technologies in core finance processes (e.g., Basware, HighRadius, BlackLine, etc.)

• Experience in using tools for process mining, visualization tools, Robotics Process Automation (RPA) and understanding of GenAI opportunities in driving transformation

• Strong process expertise in transforming and optimizing day-to-day operational functions (e.g. finance, HR) using lean methodology

• Experience in designing leading practice-based processes and driving the entire journey from assessment, design to implementation

• Superior critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Exceptional interpersonal, team-building and oral and written communication skills; outstanding integrity, initiative, creativity, and passion

• Experience with ServiceNow, Salesforce or other customer-oriented workflow platforms

• Baseline understanding and position on the current and future applications of Artificial Intelligence in GBS

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Team Lead, Software Development - Trading & Monitoring

Do you have experience leading developers – and are you more motivated by making a team succeed than by writing the code yourself? Then you may be our new Team Lead for Trading & Monitoring.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation’s “Power Major”. Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to join our Trading & Monitoring team in IT Software. Based at our headquarters in Hobro, you will have people responsibility for five developers who build and operate the platforms behind Eurowind’s energy trading and the monitoring of our parks.

Your role

This position is deliberately shaped differently from our two other team lead roles. Where they are “playing coaches” with their weight on the technical side, this one is dedicated to people and to the framework the team works within. You do not need to write code to succeed here – you need to build a team that does.

• People leadership of five developers: regular 1:1s, feedback, development plans and career paths

• Allocating tasks and areas of responsibility within the team, matching both the team’s deliverables and each individual’s skills and development goals

• Ownership of team culture, wellbeing and day-to-day ways of working

• Conflict handling within the team – you mediate between team members rather than only holding the conversations 1:1

• Recruitment and onboarding of new colleagues, together with HR and your manager

• Approving holiday and absence, and proposing salary changes within HR’s framework

• Identifying and removing blockers and delivery risks – yourself, or by escalating

• Acting as the link between the team and the wider organisation, including Trading and Commercial

• Sparring with the Product Owner, Scrum Master and architect on planning, estimation and prioritisation

You work closely with the team’s Product Owner and Scrum Master, who own what gets built and how we work respectively. Technical ownership is shared with the team’s senior developers and our architect – so you can stay focused where you make the biggest difference.

You own the how

We lead through direction and frameworks rather than close supervision. We agree the mandate and the expectations, and from there you decide the route.

• Significant autonomy in execution and real influence over how your team works

• A department with written, clarified roles (Manager, Product Owner, Scrum Master, architect and Team Lead)

• Two experienced team lead colleagues to spar with, and a steady leadership rhythm of syncs and 1:1s

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home

• Lunch scheme, coffee, tea and fruit, discount agreements and a bonus scheme

• An international environment with colleagues in 16 countries, where English is a natural part of everyday work

You will report to Senior Manager of Software Development, Daniel Otkjær, and become part of the leadership group in IT Software.

Who tends to thrive in this role

What matters most to us is demonstrated experience leading people. We are looking for someone who:

• Has several years of people management experience, ideally with developers or other specialists

• Has experience with 1:1s, feedback and development conversations – and with mediating when conflicts arise between colleagues

• Has been involved in recruitment and onboarding

• Understands agile software development and how a development team delivers

• Communicates clearly and creates direction and psychological safety in a team

• Is comfortable making decisions and standing by them

• Is fluent in Danish and English, written and spoken

A technical background – for example as a developer, tech lead or architect – is a clear plus, but not a requirement. Familiarity with energy trading or the energy sector is likewise an advantage, but something you can readily learn with us.

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record.

Renewable energy is our future. And so are our people!

At Eurowind Energy we do our best to create a culture where everyone is valued and feels at home. You will notice this in your everyday work life, where you have the freedom to speak up and where your voice means something to us. We know that when you grow, we grow. Therefore, we strive to support you in what you believe is right and in your personal and professional development. We offer you an exciting job in an energetic and international environment. And we promise you: the wind is never standing still.

Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.

We manage our own portfolio of projects and at the same time, we perform technical and financial management of projects. We have throughout many years experienced sustained economic growth in the number of developed projects and companies in management. And we continue to expect this. Simply because it is in our nature to keep developing – projects, companies and our people.
